title: Live Hostinger Production runtime parity evidence

phases.objective: Provide a workflow-dispatch-only verifier that binds the single Hostinger Production runtime auth.mad4b.com to exact protected Production DNS, TLS, HTTP, service, branch, and deployed-commit identity without conflating the independent Cloudflare local connector or planned local staging runtime.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Production Runtime Parity Evidence pull-request contract job
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Synthetic DNS, TLS, HTTP, and runtime-identity regressions plus deployment-policy assertions prove the trusted live workflow evaluates only auth.mad4b.com as Hostinger Production, rejects mismatched identity, persists bounded secret-free evidence, and leaves connector.mad4b.com and dev.mad4b.com to their separately governed runtime paths.
steps: Load the deployment branch policy and require auth.mad4b.com as the Hostinger Production hostname sourced from protected Production.
Require connector.mad4b.com to remain a non-Hostinger Cloudflare Tunnel recovery surface and dev.mad4b.com to remain non-Production local staging.
Inspect the checked-in workflow and prove live probing is workflow_dispatch-only and dispatches fail when GITHUB_REF is not refs/heads/main.
Prove trusted exact main-event checkout, full Production-ref availability, and expected_sha equality with refs/remotes/origin/Production.
Generate live evidence with exactly one required endpoint named auth and reject any workflow-level connector or dev endpoint input.
Exercise exact auth parity, required deployed-SHA drift, and untrusted identity fields while proving raw or malformed identity values are not persisted.
Reject loopback, private, link-local, documentation, multicast, invalid, and over-cardinality DNS results before TLS or HTTP execution.
Inspect bounded DNS and full-response HTTP timeout enforcement, exercise TLS failure, and verify secret redaction.
Emit a bounded secret-free component result without performing a live request in pull-request context.
assertions: The synthetic runtime report contract is mad4b.production-runtime-parity-evidence.v1.
The workflow has no push, schedule, pull_request_target, issue_comment, or deployment trigger.
Live probing runs only for workflow_dispatch; the contract job fails unless GITHUB_REF is refs/heads/main.
The workflow uses contents: read and checkout persist-credentials=false.
The live job checks out exact github.sha from a main-ref dispatch with full remote branch history and requires expected_sha to equal refs/remotes/origin/Production.
The workflow accepts only auth_url and invokes the reporter with exactly auth=https://auth.mad4b.com/version as the sole required runtime endpoint.
The workflow contains no connector_url, dev_url, require_dev, connector endpoint, or dev endpoint.
The deployment policy identifies connector.mad4b.com as Cloudflare Tunnel recovery with Hostinger Auto Deploy disabled.
The deployment policy identifies dev.mad4b.com as planned local staging with Hostinger Auto Deploy and Production traffic disabled.
DNS fails closed on loopback, private, link-local, multicast, documentation, invalid, or more than 16 returned addresses, and accepted public addresses are hashed before persistence.
The checked implementation applies bounded timeout enforcement to DNS, TLS, and the complete HTTP response body.
HTTP redirects are not followed, application/json is required, and response bodies are bounded before parsing.
The raw response body, unknown JSON fields, malformed identity values, and error details are never written to the artifact.
The required auth endpoint passes only when service equals http_generic_api_connector, deployed_commit_sha equals the exact requested SHA, and deployment branch equals Production.
Workflow enforcement requires exactly one auth endpoint, auth.required=true, auth.status=passed, first_failure=null, and tooling_sha equal to the exact trusted main event SHA.
The report declares secrets_included=false and all mutation/effect flags false.

phases.objective: Execute trusted-main live Hostinger Production readback for the exact current protected Production SHA, attach the run-bound artifact to issues 4948 and 4953, and keep connector recovery evidence in issue 4957.
Add bounded retry policy, certificate-expiry thresholds, multi-address parity, and canonical incident publication without weakening first-failure reporting.
Run the exact verifier against a separately authorized non-production Hostinger canary before future protected promotions.
Require a successful run-bound auth.mad4b.com parity artifact after every Production promotion before declaring Hostinger deployment complete.
